title: Father dies while trying to save teen son on icy California mountain hike
summary_full: Guillermo Batres was helping his son, who had slid down a hill and was clinging on to a tree, when he lost his footingA 44-year-old man who was trying to help his son navigate an icy patch of a southern California mountain trail slipped and fell roughly 500ft to his death, according to local authorities.Guillermo Batres, an avid hiker, set off on Sunday morning to summit Mount Baden-Powell in the San Gabriel mountains with his teenage son, according to Steve De Jong, a lieutenant with the Los Angeles county sheriff’s department.
